% Shared macro definitions and generated-result inputs.
% Included by both the PLOS and PeerJ wrappers so the two cannot diverge.
% Shorthand
\newcommand{\tool}{GCM}

% Local-preview figures.  PLOS requires figures to be uploaded separately and
% removed from the manuscript PDF before submission; set \showfigsfalse for the
% submission build.  When true, the generated PDFs in figures/ are embedded.
\graphicspath{{figures/}}
\newif\ifshowfigs\showfigstrue
\newcommand{\previewfig}[1]{\ifshowfigs\begin{center}%
\includegraphics[width=0.7\textwidth]{#1}\end{center}\fi}
